papers.title: Open-SAT: LLM-Guided Query Embedding Refinement for Open-Vocabulary Object Retrieval in Satellite Imagery
papers.authors: Md Adnan Arefeen, Biplob Debnath, Ravi K. Rajendran, Murugan Sankaradas, Srimat T. Chakradhar
papers.affiliations: North South University; VISVA Technologies
papers.intro: Open-SAT 是一种无需训练的推理阶段查询嵌入精炼算法，利用大语言模型（LLM）提供上下文信息，通过修改文本嵌入并采用无阈值检索机制，显著提升开放词汇卫星图像检索的准确率。

papers.title: Query2Uncertainty: Robust Uncertainty Quantification and Calibration for 3D Object Detection under Distribution Shift

papers.affiliations: Institute for Automotive Engineering, RWTH Aachen; Computer Vision Institute, RWTH Aachen
papers.intro: 本文提出一种密度感知的后处理校准方法，通过拟合DETR风格3D检测器中潜在查询特征的密度，联合校准分类置信度和回归方差，在分布内外均显著提升校准质量。

papers.title: Syn4D: A Multiview Synthetic 4D Dataset
papers.authors: Zeren Jiang, Yushi Lan, Yihang Luo, Yufan Deng, Zihang Lai, Edgar Sucar, Christian Rupprecht, Iro Laina, Diane Larlus, Chuanxia Zheng, Andrea Vedaldi

papers.intro: Syn4D是一个大规模、多视图的合成动态场景数据集，提供了密集、完整的几何和运动标注（包括相机位姿、深度、密集三维跟踪和人体姿态），旨在推动动态场景理解与时空建模的研究。

papers.authors: Dengyang Jiang, Xin Jin, Dongyang Liu, Zanyi Wang, Mingzhe Zheng, Ruoyi Du, Xiangpeng Yang, Qilong Wu, Zhen Li, Peng Gao, Harry Yang, Steven Hoi

papers.authors: Wei Luo, Yiting Lu, Xin Li, Haoran Li, Fengbin Guan, Chen Gao, Xin Jin, Yong Li, Zhibo Chen, Sijing Wu, Kang Fu, Yunhao Li, Ziang Xiao, Huiyu Duan, Jing Liu, Qiang Hu, Xiongkuo Min, Guangtao Zhai, Manxi Sun, Zixuan Guo, Yun Li, Ziyang Chen, Manabu Tsukada, Zhengyang Li, Zhenglin Du, Yi Wen, Licheng Jiao, Fang Liu, Lingling Li, Yiwen Ren, Zhilong Song, Dubing Chen, Yucheng Zhou, Tianyi Yan, Huan Zheng

papers.title: OpenSearch-VL: An Open Recipe for Frontier Multimodal Search Agents

papers.title: PhysForge: Generating Physics-Grounded 3D Assets for Interactive Virtual World
papers.authors: Yunhan Yang, Chunshi Wang, Junliang Ye, Yang Li, Zanxin Chen, Zehuan Huang, Yao Mu, Zhuo Chen, Chunchao Guo, Xihui Liu
papers.affiliations: HKU, Tencent Hunyuan, ZJU, THU, SJTU, BUAA
papers.intro: PhysForge提出一个解耦的两阶段框架，该框架首先利用视觉语言模型（VLM）作为“物理架构师”规划出带有物理约束的分层物理蓝图，然后通过一个带有新颖的运动体素注入机制的扩散模型来同步生成高保真几何和精确的运动学参数，从而从单张输入图像生成可直接用于交互式虚拟世界的物理真实感3D资源。

papers.title: Wasserstein-Aligned Localisation for VLM-Based Distributional OOD Detection in Medical Imaging
papers.authors: Bernhard Kainz, Johanna P Mueller, Matthew Baugh, Cosmin Bercea

papers.title: A Bayesian Approach for Task-Specific Next-Best-View Selection with Uncertain Geometry
papers.authors: Jingsen Zhu, Silvia Sellán, Alexander Terenin
papers.affiliations: Cornell University (Jingsen Zhu, Alexander Terenin); Columbia University (Silvia Sellán)
papers.intro: 本文提出了一种基于贝叶斯决策理论的框架，用于在三维点云重建中根据具体下游任务（分类、分割、物理模拟）选择下一个最佳视角，通过逐区域减少对任务有影响的不确定性，与传统的全局不确定性减少方法相比，在更少的视角下取得了更好的任务性能。

papers.title: A unified Benchmark for Multi-Frame Image Restoration under Severe Refractive Warping
papers.authors: Maxim V. Shugaev, Md Reshad Ul Hoque, Bridget Kennedy, Joseph T. Riley, Fiona Hwang, Justin Hagen, Harvir Ghuman, Ethan Garcia-O'Donnell, Syed Noor Qadri, Freddie Santiago, Mun Wai Lee
papers.affiliations: AeroVironment, Inc. (1), U. S. Naval Research Laboratory (2), George Mason University (3)
papers.intro: 本文提出了一个针对严重折射畸变下多帧图像恢复的统一基准，包括实验室捕获的真实数据和基于物理光折射建模的合成数据（覆盖四种波浪类型和四种畸变水平），并系统评估了从简单基线到经典配准方法再到先进学习方法（包括提出的基于扩散的 V-cache 方法）的性能，同时使用像素级和感知级指标进行大规模分析。

papers.title: FlowDIS: Language-Guided Dichotomous Image Segmentation with Flow Matching
papers.authors: Andranik Sargsyan, Shant Navasardyan
papers.affiliations: Picsart AI Research (PAIR)
papers.intro: FlowDIS提出了一种基于流匹配框架的新型二分类图像分割方法，通过学习一个时间依赖的向量场，将图像分布确定性地传输到对应的掩码分布，并配合位置感知实例配对训练策略，实现了在有无语言引导下均优于现有最先进方法的像素级精确分割。

papers.title: Height-Guided Projection Reparameterization for Camera-LiDAR Occupancy
papers.authors: Yuan Wu, Zhiqiang Yan, Jiawei Lian, Zhengxue Wang, Jian Yang
papers.affiliations: ¹Nanjing University of Science and Technology, ²National University of Singapore
papers.intro: 提出HiPR，首次利用LiDAR高度先验对2D-to-3D视图变换的投影空间进行自适应重参数化，并引入渐进式高度条件策略缓解LiDAR噪声，在保持实时推理的同时取得最先进性能。

papers.title: Look Once, Beam Twice: Camera-Primed Real-Time Double-Directional mmWave Beam Management for Vehicular Connectivity
papers.authors: Avhishek Biswas, Apala Pramanik, Eylem Ekici, Mehmet C. Vuran
papers.affiliations: School of Computing, University of Nebraska–Lincoln; Electrical and Computer Engineering, The Ohio State University
papers.intro: 本文提出VIBE，一种基于摄像头辅助的混合模型闭环学习架构，通过相机检测减少波束搜索空间，结合迭代波束细化和偏移跟踪，实现实时双方向毫米波波束管理，在室内外测试和公开数据集上显著降低中断率（1.1‑1.4%），并优于5G NR和现有端到端ML方法。

papers.title: Direct Product Flow Matching: Decoupling Radial and Angular Dynamics for Few-Shot Adaptation
papers.authors: Hongxu Chen, Yanghao Wang, Bowei Zhu, Hongxiang Li, Zhen Wang, Ziqi Jiang, Lin Li, Rui Liu, Long Chen
papers.affiliations: 1 HKUST, 2 USTC, 3 Huawei Research
papers.intro: 提出直接乘积流匹配（DP-FM），通过引入恒定扭曲度量解耦径向和角动态，在圆柱流形上实现恒速角测地线对齐，并集成分类器无指导（CFG）注入数据集特定信息，在11个少样本基准上达到新最优。

papers.title: When Relations Break: Analyzing Relation Hallucination in Vision-Language Model Under Rotation and Noise
papers.authors: Philip Wootaek Shin, Ajay Narayanan Sridhar, Sivani Devarapalli, Rui Zhang, Jack Sampson, Vijaykrishnan Narayanan
papers.affiliations: The Pennsylvania State University
papers.intro: 本文系统研究了图像旋转和噪声两种视觉扰动对VLM关系幻觉的影响，发现即使轻度扰动也会显著降低关系推理性能，并揭示了现有提示和预处理缓解策略的局限性以及感知鲁棒性与关系理解之间的差距。

papers.title: Computer-Aided Design Generation by Cascaded Discrete Diffusion Model
papers.authors: Honghu Pan, Xiaoling Luo, Yongyong Chen, Zhenyu He, Pengyang Wang
papers.affiliations: Honghu Pan：School of Artificial Intelligence and Robotics, Hunan University Xiaoling Luo：College of Computer Science and Software Engineer, Shenzhen University Yongyong Chen, Zhenyu He：School of Computer Science and Technology, Harbin Institute of Technology, Shenzhen Pengyang Wang：SKL-IOTSC, Department of Computer and Information Science, University of Macau
papers.intro: 本文提出一种级联离散扩散框架（CDDM）用于CAD生成，直接在分类token分布上操作，通过精心设计的转移矩阵实现符号感知的噪声过程，避免了连续扩散造成的语义无效问题。

papers.title: Prompt-Anchored Vision-Text Distillation for Lifelong Person Re-identification
papers.authors: Wen Wen, Hao Chen, Shiliang Zhang
papers.affiliations: 1. 电子科技大学 (University of Electronic Science and Technology of China)  2. 哈尔滨工业大学 (深圳) (Harbin Institute of Technology, Shenzhen)  3. 北京大学 (Peking University)
papers.intro: 提出Prompt-Anchored Vision-Text Distillation (PAD)，一种利用冻结文本编码器作为稳定语义锚点，通过非对称视觉-文本蒸馏实现终身行人重识别中稳定性与塑性平衡的无范例框架。

papers.title: Local Intrinsic Dimension Unveils Hallucinations in Diffusion Models
papers.authors: Bartlomiej Sobieski, Matthew Tivnan, Dawid Płudowski, Michał Jan Włodarczyk, Pengfei Jin, Przemyslaw Biecek, Quanzheng Li
papers.affiliations: Centre for Credible AI, Warsaw University of Technology；University of Warsaw；Massachusetts General Hospital；Harvard Medical School
papers.intro: 本文提出将扩散模型的结构性幻觉视为模型诱导流形上的局部不稳定性，识别局部固有维度（LID）膨胀为核心驱动因素，并设计Intrinsic Quenching（IQ）机制在采样过程中动态降低LID以抑制幻觉，理论证明且实验优于现有基线。
